hero.lede: We wash with steam, not a hose. Your car comes back clean inside and out, on a fraction of the water, with nothing rubbing against the paint.

studio.title: We do fewer services, and we do them better.
studio.lede: When we opened we decided two things: never take on more cars than fit in a day, and always tell you what we did to yours. That has not changed.

steam-wash.name: Touch-free steam wash
steam-wash.short: Pressure-controlled steam lifts dirt away without touching the paint.

dry-interior.name: Dry interior clean
dry-interior.short: Upholstery, plastics and headlining cleaned dry. It leaves with no damp, so you can drive it straight away.

paint-correction.name: Paint and headlight correction
paint-correction.short: We take out the fine scratches and holograms left by roller washes, and bring the reflection back.

ceramic-coating.name: Ceramic coating
ceramic-coating.short: A hard, water-repellent layer: rain slides off and dirt has a much harder time sticking.

paint-protection-film.name: Paint protection film
paint-protection-film.short: Clear film across the front end and impact zones, against stones and scratches.

window-tint.name: Window tinting
window-tint.short: Heat control and privacy with fully road-legal film.

decontamination.name: Iron decontamination
decontamination.short: We pull embedded metal particles out before any polishing starts.

engine-bay.name: Engine bay clean
engine-bay.short: Bay degreased and dressed, with every connector sealed first.

trim-restoration.name: Trim restoration
trim-restoration.short: Faded mouldings and bumpers taken back to their original black.

about.label: About
about.title: A small workshop that works slowly.
about.lede: We are a short team and we like it that way.
about.p1: Vaporix started because we were tired of leaving a car somewhere and getting it back with no idea what had been done to it. We opened with one bay, one steam machine and a rule: never take on more work than fits in a day.
about.p2: The rule still holds. We use steam because it takes far less water than a hose and cleans without rubbing the paint. And if you want to know what went on your car, we will tell you.

care.name: No rushing
care.desc: One car per bay, per slot. We never overlap jobs to squeeze another in.

honesty.name: Fixed price
honesty.desc: What we quote before we start is what you pay. If something turns up, we call you.

steam.name: Steam, not a hose
steam.desc: Less water, no contact with the paint, and no harsh chemicals inside the cabin.
